name: How long does a typical high-end finish carpentry project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical high-end finish carpentry project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a high-end finish carpentry project varies significantly based on its scope, complexity, and the availability of custom materials. A small trim upgrade might take a few days, while extensive custom built-ins or full room transformations could span several weeks. Factors like drying times for finishes and coordination with other trades also influence the timeline. Maine Results, Inc. provides a project schedule after the design and material selections are finalized, giving you a clear expectation of completion.
